chemical_cells.name: Chemical Battery (Cells in Series)
chemical_cells.description: Source of electromotive force (EMF); converts chemical potential energy into electrical energy to establish an electric potential gradient.

switch_component.name: Control Switch
switch_component.description: Mechanical device used to close (complete) or open (break) the conducting loop, starting or halting the flow of charge.

ammeter_series.name: Ammeter (Series Connection)
ammeter_series.description: Instrument possessing near-zero internal resistance connected strictly in series to measure the rate of charge flow (current in Amperes).

junction_node_left.name: Branching Junction Node
junction_node_left.description: Parallel division point where incoming total current splits into multiple independent path currents according to Kirchhoff's current law.

load_resistor_1.name: Resistor 1 (Branch 1)
load_resistor_1.description: First resistive load component; converts electrical energy into thermal energy, presenting a fixed electrical resistance (R₁) to charge flow.

load_resistor_2.name: Resistor 2 (Branch 2)
load_resistor_2.description: Second resistive load component connected across identical potential difference; presents fixed electrical resistance (R₂) allowing independent branch current.

voltmeter_parallel.name: Voltmeter (Parallel Connection)
voltmeter_parallel.description: Instrument possessing exceptionally high internal resistance connected across a component in parallel to measure potential difference in Volts.

conducting_wires.name: Conducting Wires (Copper)
conducting_wires.description: Low-resistance metal pathways containing delocalized conduction electrons that drift through the lattice to transfer electrical energy.
